sloka: कालाग्निरिव सङ्क्रुद्धो यां यां दिशमवैक्षत।तस्यां तस्यां भयत्रस्ता राक्षसाः संविलिल्यिरे ।। ६.९३.२५ ।।
transliteration: kālāgniriva saṅkruddho yāṁ yāṁ diśamavaikṣata।tasyāṁ tasyāṁ bhayatrastā rākṣasāḥ saṁvililyire ।। 6.93.25 ।।

translations.english: Fearing Ravana who was enraged like the time of universal destruction, the Rakshasashid themselves in the very quarter he was looking.
